_what: Identifier-mapping fixture (SPEC-027, decision D-006 option (c)). Maps each golden-fixture variant_id to the external identifiers resources key on. Contains IDENTIFIERS ONLY -- no scores, no predictions, no third-party licensed data.
_why_committed: UniProtKB accessions are facts about proteins, not domain criteria and not anyone's prediction output. UniProtKB is CC BY 4.0 (attribution). Contrast fixtures that would contain AlphaMissense scores -- those are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and are NOT committed (see docs/alphamissense-data.md).
_provisional: Hand-built for the golden fixture. When pipeline/annotation/ (Funcotator) and SPEC-004 exist they populate this SAME shape from real callsets and this file is retired. The consuming producer does not change.
_verification: Each accession was retrieved from the UniProtKB REST API (reviewed/Swiss-Prot, organism_id 9606) on 2026-07-28 and independently corroborated for KRAS (P01116) and BRAF (P15056) by the uniprot_id column of real rows in AlphaMissense_hg38.tsv.gz. AlphaMissense used UniProt release 2021_02 canonical isoforms; these accessions are stable Swiss-Prot primary accessions.
source: UniProtKB REST API (rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search, reviewed:true, organism_id:9606), retrieved 2026-07-28
